overview_description.description: Sennder is a digital road freight forwarder that links commercial shippers with freight carriers. It provides automation, transparency, and efficiency with its in-house-developed platform for the freight market. They digitalize the truckload-shipping ecosystem by providing mobile apps to drivers, fleet management tools to carrier managers, and logistics management solutions to shippers. The company offers real-time booking as well as precise live tracking, bringing full transparency to any logistics supply chain. It integrates directly with the shippers’ transport management and freight management systems via APIs and by cutting the multiple middlemen, it increases efficiency and reduces cost for all stakeholders.

product.name: sennOS Digital Platform
product.description: An end-to-end digital platform managing the entire shipment lifecycle to improve transparency, efficiency, and provide insights in road freight logistics.

product.name: Shipper Portal
product.description: A self-service web portal for shippers to book, track, and manage full truckload capacity with real-time visibility and pricing options.

product.name: Carrier Portal
product.description: A digital platform for carriers to find, manage, and maximize earnings from freight loads across their fleet.

product.name: Sennder App
product.description: A mobile application for carriers to book loads, track shipments, communicate, and manage payments from anywhere.

product.name: Digital Freight Forwarding Services
product.description: Full truckload freight forwarding connecting shippers directly with carriers to provide flexible, visible, and cost-controlled road transport solutions.

product.name: Green Business Solutions
product.description: Sustainability-focused logistics services using advanced biofuels, electric vehicles, and intermodal transport to reduce carbon emissions in road freight.
